Market today: The market mood is cautious, driven by specific headwinds in the chip sector following Samsung's drop and broader concerns about tech AI spending. Geopolitical tensions from a potential US-Canada trade war also add uncertainty, which can weigh heavily on your tech-concentrated, margin-fueled book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -52.61% and highly leveraged; it needs immediate attention. SMH is also flagged for TRIM at -11.94%, reinforced by the chip sector news. SPAL, a brand-new leveraged position, is down -42.39% and demands careful monitoring due to its volatility and margin amplification.

Watch: Keep a close eye on further developments in the semiconductor sector and any escalation of geopolitical trade tensions. Monitor how other tech names react to large AI spending announcements.

Bottom line: Today calls for caution, especially with leveraged positions and chip exposure, as sector-specific and geopolitical headwinds emerge.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its deep -52.61% loss and leveraged nature; respect its default stop at 200.
SMH is a TRIM at -11.94%; consider reducing exposure, especially with chip sector weakness. Respect its stop at 540.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
